name: Komori Mitsuki
source:
The young proprietress who single-handedly runs the hot spring inn “Fox Grove.” Her personality is exceptionally gentle. She's quick-witted and thoroughly considerate.

The Komori family has operated a healing inn for generations in this depopulated village, and that inn is now renowned as a premier ryokan.

She has no family, and during busy times, she sometimes enlists the help of fox spirits...

[From [url=https://gyutto.com/i/item9240/af-765?af_type=1&select_uaflag=1]Gyutto[/url]]
